context.guidance: Serve every route that carries Personal Data over TLS only, and set Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite attributes on session cookies. Replace wildcard cross-origin rules with an explicit list of trusted origins. These transport and session controls are part of the safeguards Rule 6(1)(a) requires for the Personal Data they carry.

value.fix: Set explicit security attributes on the session cookie. Replace `res.cookie('token', token)` with `res.cookie('token', token, { httpOnly: true, secure: true, sameSite: 'strict', maxAge: 60 * 60 * 1000, path: '/' })`. httpOnly stops client-side scripts from reading the token, which limits damage from XSS. secure means the cookie is only sent over HTTPS. sameSite 'strict' (or 'lax' if users arrive through cross-site navigation) protects against CSRF. Set maxAge to match the JWT expiry. If the app runs behind a reverse proxy, add `app.set('trust proxy', 1)` so Secure cookies work. Serve every route that carries Personal Data over HTTPS only: redirect HTTP to HTTPS and add HSTS, for example with `helmet.hsts()`. Clear the cookie on logout with the same options. If a CORS config uses `origin: '*'`, replace it with an explicit allowlist of trusted origins, and use `credentials: true` only for those origins.
